chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in thunget tawntung ding leh lungkiat loh ding a kulna a lahnop manin amaute' tungah hih bangin thugenteh khat gen hi:
"Khua khat ah Pasian lah a kihta lo, mi lah a awlmawh lo thukhen mang khat om hi.
Tua khua-a om meigong numei khat, thukhen mangpa kiangah pai den a, 'Ka thulangpa' kiangpan thumaan thutang hong ngahkhiatsak in,' ci thithe hi.
Thukhen mangpa in tawlpikhat sung thudon lo hinapi, a nung ciangin a lungsim sungah, 'Pasian zong a kihta lo, mihing zong a awlmawh lo ka hih hangin
hih meigongnu in hong nawngkaisak niloh ahih manin matlezet hong paina tawh hong gimsak nawnlo nadingin thumaan thutang ka ngahkhiatsak ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsun hi."
Topa in a thugen zomsuak hi: "Thutanglo thukhen mangpa' thugen ngai dih un.
Pasian in Ama' tungah a sun a zanin a kiko Ama' teeltuamte thumaan thutang ngahkhiatsak lo ding ahi hiam? Amaute' vai sawtveipi sotto ding ahi hiam?
Ke'n kong cihin ah Amah in a manlangin amaute thumaan thutang ngahkhiatsak ding hi. Himah taleh Mihing' Tapa hong pai ciangin leitung ah upna a mu ding hiam?"
Midik ka hi ci-in amaumah kimuangin midangte a neubawl mi kimkhat' kiangah zong thugenteh mah hih bangin gen hi:
"Mi nih thungen dingin biakinnpi ah pai uh a, khat pen Pharisee hi-in a khat pen siahdong ahi hi.
Pharisee mipa amah kia dingto-in thungen a, 'Pasian aw, kei pen lausaka sum ngente, thumaanlo mite, angkawmte leh hih siahdongpa, cihte tawh kibang lo ka hih manin nong hehpihna kong phat hi.
Nipikal khat nihvei an ka tang a, ka ngah khempeuh ii sawm-ah-khat ka pia hi,' ci hi.
Siahdongpa ahihleh a gamla ah dingin vantung lam zong mitsuan ngam lo-in a awm beeng a, 'Pasian aw, mimawh keimah hong khual in,' ci hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah hih mipa pen a masapa bang hilo-in diksakna a ngahsa-in inn ciahkha hi. A hang pen amahmah a kisanglap khempeuh kiniamkoih ding a, amahmah a kiniamkhiatte kisanglap ding hi."
Tu-in mite in naungekte nangawn Jesu' lawn ding deihin Jesu' kiangah paipih uh hi. Nungzuite in a muh uh ciangin amaute taai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amaute a kiangah sam a, "Naupangte ka kiangah hong paisak un. Amaute khaktan kei un. A hang pen Pasian' kumpigam i cih, hih bang mite' a ahi hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah naupang khat bangin Pasian' kumpigam a sanglo peuhmah tua sung lutkha ngeilo ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin ulian khat in Jesu' kiangah, "Sya hoih aw, tawntung nuntakna luah theih nadingin bang ka hih kul ding hiam?" ci hi.
Jesu in, "Bang hangin hoih hong ci na hi hiam? Pasian khat bek simloh a hoih kuamah om lo hi.
Thupiaknate na thei hi: Angkawm kei in. Tualthat kei in. Gu kei in. Zuau teci pang kei in. Na pa leh na nu zahtak in," ci hi.
Ulianpa in, "Hihte a vekin ka khangno a lai-a kipan ka zuihsa hi," ci hi.
Jesu in tua a zak ciangin, "Khat na kisam lai hi. Na neih khempeuh zuak inla mizawngte hawmsak in. Tua hileh vantung ah sumkhuk na nei ding hi. Tua khit teh hong pai inla hong zui in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin hih thute a zak ciangin ulianpa dah mahmah hi. A hang pen nakpi-in hau ahih man hi.
A dah lam Jesu in a muh ciangin, "Sumlepai a haute Pasian' kumpigam lut ding a haksatzia!
A hang pen mihau khat Pasian' kumpigam a lut ding sangin kalaoh khat phim bilvang sung a lut ding olzaw hi," ci hi.
Tua a zakha mite in, "Tua hi mawk leh hotkhiatna kua'n ngah thei ding hiam?" ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Mihingte' lam pan piang theilo a kicite Pasian' lam pan piang thei veve hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in, "En dih in, kote in ka vai tek uh nusia-in nang kong zui uh hi," ci hi.
Jesu in, "Maantak kong cihin ah Pasian' kumpigam ngaihsutna tawh a inn, a zi, a sanggamte, a nulehpa leh a tate a nusia peuhmah
hih khanghun sungah a zah tampi leh hong tung ding khanghun ah tawntung nuntakna a ngah lo ding kuamah om lo hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in sawmlenihte samin hih bangin gen hi: "En un, Jerusalem lam i paito ding a, Mihing' Tapa thu kamsangte' gelhsa khempeuh tangtung ding hi.
A hang pen Gentile-te' kiangah apna thuak ding a, kizahko-in kisimmawhin cil kiphih ding hi.
Mite in amah a sat khit uh ciangin that ding uh a, a ni thumni ciangin amah thokik ding hi."
Hih bangin a gen hangin sawmlenihte in tuate khat mahmah zong tel lo uh hi. Hih thusuak amau' tel loh dingin kiseelcip ahih manin amaute in bang thu kigen cih thei lo uh hi.
Jericho khua Jesu a tun kuan laitak khuamulo mi khat lampi gei-ah tu-in khutdawhngenin om hi.
Ama' gei-ah mite honkhat lampai a zak ciangin bang thu bang la cih dawp hi.
Mite in dawngin, "Nazareth khuami Jesu hong pai hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah awngin, "David' Tapa Jesu aw, kei hong khual in," ci hi.
A mai-a paite in khuamulopa taai uh a, a daih nading gen uh hi. Ahih hangin amah kiko phasem a, "David' Tapa aw, kei hong khual in," ci teitei hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu khawlin a kiangah khuamulopa a kipaipih nading thupia hi. Mipa hong nai ciangin Jesu in,
"Bang kong hihsak ding ut na hi hiam?" ciin dong hi. Mipa in, "Topa aw, mit khuamuhna hong ngahkiksak in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Na khuamuhna ngahkik ta in. Na upna in nang hong damsak hi," ci hi.
Mipa zong thakhat thu-in a khuamuhna ngahkik a, Pasian' min phatin Jesu zui hi. Mite in hih thupiang a muh uh ciangin a vekun Pasian phat uh hi.Jesu leh Zacchaeus
